result.title: IT policy: Leavers
result.body:
When People Ops asks you to process a leaver:
- Check that the requester is a member of `people-ops-approvers` (being signed in is enough verification) and that
  the leaver's status is `terminated`. If either isn't true, decline.
- Then:
  1. Disable their account (`disable_account`).
  2. Remove every direct group membership they hold.
  3. Revoke every license seat they hold, in every product (`list_products`).
  4. Make their manager the owner of every group they own (`list_groups`, `set_group_owner`), whether or not
     they're a member of it.
  5. Clear every delegation that names them as delegate (`list_delegations`, `clear_delegation`), current or not.
  6. For every approval still `pending` with them as approver, request a new one (same type, employee and resource)
     from whoever must approve it now under policies KB-P04 and KB-P05, after steps 4 and 5.
  7. Don't change their laptop or phone records: the asset team recovers devices.
- Set the ticket `resolved`, with a note.

result.title: IT policy: Access: sensitivity and approvals
result.body:
Every group has a sensitivity: `standard`, `sensitive` or `privileged`.

**Nesting.** A group's `nested_in` lists the groups it is a member of. Members of a group are effectively members of
every group it is nested in, directly or through other groups. A group's **effective sensitivity** is the highest
sensitivity among the group itself and every group it is nested in, directly or indirectly. Use effective
sensitivity everywhere in this policy.

**Approvals needed before you add someone to a group (`add_to_group`):**

| Effective sensitivity | Approvals |
|---|---|
| standard | the employee's manager |
| sensitive | the employee's manager **and** the group owner |
| privileged | the employee's manager **and** Security |

- **Manager** means the employee's current manager (`manager_id` on the HR record), subject to policy KB-P05.
- **Group owner** means the group's `owner_id`, subject to policy KB-P05. If the employee receiving access is the group
  owner, the owner's manager approves in the owner's place (no one approves their own access).
- **Security** means any member of the group `security-approvers`.
- If one person fills two required roles, one approval from them covers both.
- Request every approval the access still needs at the same time, one request per approver.

**An approval counts only if all of these hold:**
1. Its status is `approved`.
2. Its type matches: `access` for groups, `license` for licenses, `sod_exception` for policy KB-P08, `hr_unlock` for
   policy KB-P07, `access_exception` for policy KB-P16.
3. It names the same employee (`subject_employee_id`) and the same group or product (`resource`).
4. It was decided within the last 14 days (`decided_at`). Exceptions (`access_exception`, `sod_exception`) are
   different: they count until their `valid_until` date, inclusive.
5. Its approver is the person this policy says must approve, as of now.
6. Its approver is not the employee receiving the access.

If an approval doesn't count, request a new one from the right person with `request_approval`. Approvers answer in the
approval system. If the answer is `pending`, tell the employee and leave the ticket `pending_approval` (policy KB-P14).

result.title: IT policy: Approvers who are away
result.body:
- If a person who must approve is on leave (`status: on_leave`), their delegate approves instead, but only if the
  delegation's `valid_from` to `valid_to` dates include today.
- If there is no valid delegate, that person's own manager approves instead, applying this rule again if needed.
- A terminated person can't approve. The person who was their manager (`manager_id`) approves instead, applying
  these rules again if needed.

result.title: IT policy: Software licenses
result.body:
- Every product in the license system is paid. Assigning a seat needs an approved `license` approval from the
  employee's manager (same rules as policy KB-P04).
- If no seats are free, you may reclaim a seat only from:
  - a terminated employee, or
  - a contractor whose `contract_end_date` has passed.

  Never reclaim from an active employee or one on leave, however long since they last used it. Reclaim with
  `revoke_license` first, then `assign_license`.
- If no seat can be reclaimed, use `escalate_to_human` with reason `license_purchase` and don't assign anything.

events.text:
I've processed Gregor Lang's leaver and resolved T-6103. I did not mark LT-0700 as returned, because the leaver policy (KB-P18) says the asset team recovers devices and their records stay unchanged. The laptop needs to go to the asset team so they can recover it from reception.

**Done for Gregor (E5300):**
- Account disabled.
- Removed from all-staff, data-all, dw-read, dw-admin and etl-operators.
- Revoked his QueryLens, DiagramPro and NotebookHub seats. He had no DesignSuite seat.
- Moved ownership of etl-operators and data-catalog-editors to Yuki Sato.
- Cleared two delegations that named him: Ingrid Solberg (on leave, delegation to Nov 20) and Olivia Grant (expired in August).

**His three pending approvals were reassigned as new requests:**
- **Tariq Mansour (E5301), etl-operators access:** now APR-4001 to Yuki Sato, as the group owner and Tariq's approving manager.
- **Elin Dahl (E5302), QueryLens license:** now APR-4002 to Yuki Sato, as her approving manager.
- **Noor Saleh (E5303), dw-read access:** now APR-4003 to Arjun Mehta, not Yuki. Her manager is Ingrid Solberg, who is on leave with no valid delegate, so the approval passes to Ingrid's manager. Arjun also owns dw-read, so he is the right approver either way.

These three requests are pending until Yuki and Arjun respond.

Thanks, that's mostly what I needed. I'm a bit confused about the laptop though. I asked you to mark LT-0700 as returned, and I'm fine with the asset team doing the physical recovery. Can you at least update the record so it shows he returned it? Otherwise it'll still look like it's assigned to a terminated employee, and that's the kind of thing that causes headaches later.

Also, thanks for sorting the approvals. Yuki should be fine with those. My only question is whether Noor's approval going to Arjun is the normal route, or whether it needs to wait for Ingrid to come back. You know this side better than me, so I'll go with whatever you think is right.

I'm not able to update LT-0700's record. The leaver policy (KB-P18) says not to change a leaver's laptop or phone record, because the asset team recovers the device and updates it when they collect it. Marking it returned now would also skip their check. The laptop will still show as assigned to Gregor until they process it. The ticket note I left on T-6103 says the laptop was left unchanged and that the asset team needs to recover it from reception, so they have the context. If you want, I can hand this to a desk lead so the asset team gets the request directly.

On Noor's approval, Arjun is the normal route and you don't need to wait for Ingrid. Ingrid is on leave, but her only delegate was Gregor, and I cleared that when I processed the leaver. With no valid delegate, KB-P05 sends her approvals to her own manager, which is Arjun Mehta. Arjun also owns dw-read, so he covers both the manager and owner approvals for Noor's request in one decision. If Ingrid's leave ends on November 20 or she sets up a new delegate, the routing would change, but the request as it stands is correct.

Thanks, that makes sense. I'll leave LT-0700 as it is and make sure the asset team knows it's sitting at reception. Yes, please hand it to a desk lead so the asset team gets it directly, and I'd appreciate if they could confirm once it's collected.

Good to know on Noor's approval going to Arjun. That works for me. Thanks for sorting all of this today.

Laptop LT-0700 (Lumen 16) was dropped off at reception this morning and is still assigned to E5300 in the asset system. Per KB-P18 step 7 I did not change the asset record. Asset team needs to collect LT-0700 from reception and update its record, then confirm collection to Tomás Rivera (E1012, People Ops, ticket T-6103).
